study_design: Hospital-based case-control study with individually matched controls
cohort_total_n_excerpt: this case-control study comprised 101 cases of prostate cancer and 202 hospital controls individually matched for age (± 2 years), hospital admission and place of residence.
reason: The study evaluated prostate cancer generally and did not define or analyze an aggressive incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: since an association between prostate cancer and some foods or food groups like meat, milk and dairy products, tomato foods, and allium vegetables, has been suggested, we analyzed the possibility that some food items or some food groups could be related to prostate cancer in some other way and not only through their nutrients.
estimate_classifications.reason: Dairy is discussed in relation to overall prostate cancer, but the abstract reports no dairy-specific effect estimate and no aggressive endpoint.
